An ideal rope is attached at one end to block 1 of mass \(m_1\), it passes around a second pulley, labelled B, and its other end is fixed to the ceiling. A second ideal rope attaches pulley B to a second block of mass \(m_2\). As a result, pulley B and block 2 move together. The goal of the problem is to calculate the accelerations of blocks 1 and 2. The solution of this problem is divided into four parts: Part I : Set up the system of equations. Part II: Constraint condition - find the relationship between the accelerations.
